com.vector.cfg.model.sysdesc.api.port

Interface IPortInterface

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IHasModelObject, IIdentifiable, IModelAbstraction

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IPortInterface
extends IIdentifiable
    A IPortInterface represents a port interface according to AUTOSAR. A port interface is an interface that is either provided or required by a port of a software component.

    • Method Detail

      • getElementNames

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Collection<java.lang.String> getElementNames()
        Retrieves short names of the elements of this IPortInterface.

        Examples:
        For sender receiver and NV data interfaces the elements are the variable data prototypes.
        For client server interfaces the elements are the client server operations.
        For trigger interfaces the elements are the triggers.
        For parameter interfaces the elements are the parameter data prototypes.
        For mode switch interfaces the elements are the mode groups.
        Returns:
        A collection containing the short name of each element of this IPortInterface.

      • getElementsAsMdfObjects

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Collection<com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.base.MIIdentifiable> getElementsAsMdfObjects()
        Retrieves the mdf model objects of the elements of this IPortInterface.

        Examples:
        For sender receiver and NV data interfaces the elements are the variable data prototypes.
        For client server interfaces the elements are the client server operations.
        For trigger interfaces the elements are the triggers.
        For parameter interfaces the elements are the parameter data prototypes.
        For mode switch interfaces the elements are the mode groups.
        Returns:
        A collection containing the one mdf model object for each element of this IPortInterface.
